description: This file defines the NullCoalesceBinary class, which implements the null coalescing operator (`??`) for Twig templates, providing logic to handle null coalescing expressions during template compilation.

classes.name: NullCoalesceBinary
classes.description: A class representing the binary null coalescing operator (`??`) in Twig, used to compile template expressions that specify default values if a variable is null or undefined.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the left and right expressions, adding a 'test' node for defined and null tests if the left expression is not a NameExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the null coalescing operator into PHP code, optimizing for the case where a test node is present.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw string representation of the operator (`??`).

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns which operands should be escaped, depending on whether a 'test' node exists.
